title: POST /v1/enroll request
description: The one-time registration, and the one unsigned protocol request. Gated by exactly one claim: a single-use server-minted invite (the interactive path) or a multi-use server-minted grant (the managed path, carried in the enroll command fleet management distributes). It is the only moment the service learns anything about an install: id, device key, public age recipient, and cosmetics. The server decodes this request strictly -- an unknown field is a 400, unlike /v1/config.

invite.description: Server-minted claim, opaque to the client. Bounded expiry and single use: an identical completed enrollment retry succeeds, while changed enrollment material is refused.

grant.description: The managed-enrollment claim: an opaque token, multi-use, distributed fleet-wide rather than minted per machine. The server looks it up in its own store, where its expiry and revocation live. Exactly one of invite or grant is set; both or neither is a 400.

install_id.description: Client-generated UUID, this install's identity from here on. Not renameable: it is baked into every object key.

device_public_key.description: Base64 32-byte ed25519 public key. Every later request is verified against it -- the server reads it fresh from the enrollment record per request.

age_recipient.description: The install's age X25519 recipient -- the PUBLIC half only, no private key material ever leaves the machine. Lets the org add this install as a recipient if policy says so.

hostname.description: Cosmetic. Seeds the display name so dashboard lists read as machines.
